title: You’re using Claude Code wrong. #claudecode
description:
Most people are using Claude Code wrong.

It's not actually an agent until you give it access to the right tools. That's the unlock.

I gave it one prompt: find 10 mid-market companies that fit our ICP, pull the decision makers with real emails and LinkedIn profiles, research what they're working on, and build me a hosted prospect report I can share with my team.

A few minutes later I had a full sales research pipeline. 10 companies, 10 decision makers, personalized outreach angles for each, all on a live link.

This used to take an SDR an entire day.

Comment "Agent" for the full step by step

Let me know what you'd have your agent do!
